usedFor: Membrain holds sales opportunities, and Freshsales Classic mirrors changes with “Update Deal” after “Opportunity Is Updated”.

bestTemplate.name: “Opportunity Is Updated” in Membrain, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: An updated opportunity updates the matching deal, so two sales tools tell the same story.

watchOut: “Opportunity Is Updated” is polling, so “Update Deal” runs after a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
